== Biography ==
Elizabeth Dick’s birth date is not established; around 1767 is a working estimate.
== Research Notes ==
=== Possible Edinburgh death in 1844 ===

A derivative transcript records Elizabeth “Dick Or Glasgow”, aged 89, dying on 11 June 1844 and buried on 14 June 1844, resident at No 4 Norton Place, Edinburgh. It calls her the relict of “Peter Glurgow”, preserving that literal reading. The reference is OPR 685_3/34, item 2, page 291.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBUR%2F1591550 Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Deaths &amp; Burials 1564–2017, Elizabeth Dick Or Glasgow], death 11 June and burial 14 June 1844, age 89, relict of Peter Glurgow, No 4 Norton Place, OPR 685_3/34, item 2, page 291; derivative transcript inspected 4 November 2026, original uninspected.</ref>

Elizabeth Dick, wife of [[Glasgow-1466|Peter Glasgow]], remains a compatible candidate. The paired names support comparison with their Bathgate family, but no source bridges that family to Norton Place. Age 89 implies a birth between 12 June 1754 and 11 June 1755, about twelve years earlier than the weak circa-1767 estimate. Both chronologies permit the 1783–1795 child sequence, so the discrepancy needs investigation rather than a second Elizabeth. No death or burial is assigned.

The relict clause applies to the husband named in this record; it does not establish a death-before-1844 boundary for Peter Glasgow-1466. “Peter Glurgow” is not silently corrected to a proved profile identity. Dick/Glasgow are dual surname forms here, consistent with a Dick woman’s married Glasgow usage; this is not evidence that she was born Glasgow.
